server.name: Ramp MCP Remote
server.version: A hosted MCP server to allow LLMs to talk to Ramp

tools.name: ramp_rate_list_categories
tools.description:
List Categories

List all available Ramp Rate software categories, call this first to discover valid category names.
Returns a list of category objects each with a 'software_category' field
(e.g. 'CRM', 'Observability', 'Communication').

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

tools.name: ramp_rate_get_category_summary
tools.description:
Get Category Summary

Get adoption stats for a single software category including adoption rate,
YoY/MoM change, growth rank, vendor count, and FTE segment breakdown.
Example: {"category": "CRM"}. Call ramp_rate_list_categories first to discover valid category names.

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

tools.name: ramp_rate_get_category_vendors
tools.description:
Get Category Vendors

Get ranked vendor leaderboard within a category.
Returns per-vendor adoption rates, spend share, growth metrics, and competitive rankings.
Note: competitor_switch_rate is the share of within-category switchers who chose this vendor (a win rate among switchers), NOT a retention or churn rate.
Example: {"category": "CRM", "limit": 10}.
Call ramp_rate_list_categories first to discover valid category names.

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

tools.name: ramp_rate_resolve_vendor
tools.description:
Resolve Vendor

Resolve a vendor name to its canonical slug and list its software categories.
Pass a human-readable vendor name and get back the vendor_slug needed by other tools.
Example: {"vendor_name": "Slack"} returns {"vendor_slug": "slack-technologies", "software_categories": ["Communication"]}.

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

tools.name: ramp_rate_get_vendor_profile
tools.description:
Get Vendor Profile

Get a vendor's Ramp Rate profile across all categories it belongs to.
Accepts a canonical vendor slug and can recover from common vendor names, domains,
Slack links, Markdown links, and public Ramp vendor URLs.
Example: {"vendor_slug": "slack-technologies"}.

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

vendor_slug.title: vendor_slug
vendor_slug.description: Canonical vendor slug returned by ramp_rate_resolve_vendor, or a vendor name/domain/URL to resolve (e.g. 'slack-technologies', 'datadog')

tools.name: ramp_rate_compare_vendors
tools.description:
Compare Vendors

Compare adoption metrics across 2-10 vendors side by side.
Requires vendor_slugs (call ramp_rate_resolve_vendor first to get slugs from names).
Example: {"vendor_slugs": ["slack-technologies", "salesforce"]}.

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

vendor_slugs.title: vendor_slugs
vendor_slugs.description: List of canonical vendor slugs returned by ramp_rate_resolve_vendor (2-10)

tools.name: ai_index_get_adoption
tools.description:
Get Ai Adoption

Get AI adoption snapshot with vendor breakdown.
Returns a list of monthly records, each containing the overall AI adoption
share and per-vendor adoption shares (e.g. OpenAI, Google, Anthropic).
Per-vendor shares can overlap because customers may use multiple AI vendors.
Use `months` to request up to 120 months of history (default 1); available history begins around January 2023, so fewer months may be returned.

rationale.title: rationale
rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.

months.title: months
months.description: Number of months of historical data to return (1–120, default 1); available history begins around January 2023, so fewer months may be returned.

tools.description:

Get AI adoption broken down by industry sector.
Returns a list of monthly records with per-sector AI adoption shares
(e.g. Technology, Healthcare, Finance).
Use `months` to request up to 120 months of history (default 1).
